module: Entry point of the third-party lua-websockets library (Gerhard Lipp, MIT license), a pure-Lua WebSocket (RFC 6455) implementation. This module groups the client and server submodules (loaded on demand) and the frame opcode constants. It is loaded via require('libs/lua-websockets/websocket').
usage:
local ws = require('libs/lua-websockets/websocket')
local c = ws.client.new({timeout = 2})
local ok, err = c:connect('ws://127.0.0.1:8080', 'echo')
if ok then c:send('hello', ws.TEXT) end
notes: The internal requires use the path 'libs/lua-websockets/websocket.frame' (with a dot); this is Lua's require convention, equivalent to a slash.
The 'ev' backends (client_ev, server_ev) require the 'ev' library (lua-ev) and the 'copas' backends require 'libs/copas/copas'; without these dependencies, the require fails.

client.desc: Lazy table (see websocket/client.lua): client.new / client.sync (synchronous backend), client.copas, client.ev.

CONTINUATION.desc: Opcode 0: continuation frame of a fragmented message.
